messages:
Sam Park: Heads-up — need a compact asset pack for next Tue webinar + an inbound lead routing diagram for the benchmark playbook. TL;DR: one-pager benchmark, 3 micro-tiles (social + email), webinar hero, and email header. Brand/legal check needed. Target: Mon EOD for internal review. @jonas @maya

Jonas Li: Got it. Can you share usage contexts and CTA variants?

Sam Park: Use cases: webinar registration page, sales one-pager PDF, and MQL nurture email. CTAs: "Register", "Download benchmark", "Talk to sales". Size constraints: hero 1200x628, tiles 600x600, email header 600x200. Diagrams should be provided as SVG + PNG.

Maya Ortiz: For routing diagram — keep it simple: ad -> landing -> webinar reg -> HubSpot property mapping -> routing rules -> SDR queue. Needs to fit a slide (1200px width). I'll add annotations for HubSpot field names.

Jonas Li: I'll do low-fi comps by Fri. Art direction: use brand primary + accent, minimal data viz. Benchmark tile should include a tiny sparkline + single stat highlight. Example copy suggested: "Reduced unit cost observed in benchmark X†" — marketing to confirm.

Priya Shah: Brand note: avoid unverified comparative claims. Use approved typography and tokenized colors. Also: use 'Redwood' (capital R) in headers. I'll drop the palette and type token link in the file.

Alex Kim: Figma file created and permissions set: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/benchmark-playbook
Export spec: PNG @2x for web, SVG for diagrams, PDF for the one-pager. I'll add naming conventions and export slices.

LegalBot: Quick legal check — no named-competitor comparisons. Replace 'lower cost' with 'reduced unit cost' and include a footnote with methodology. Avoid superlatives.

Sam Park: OK—copy updated. New stat line: "Reduced unit cost observed in benchmark X†". Maya will add the footnote. Sales ops fields to map: "redwood_source", "benchmark_tag", "webinar_reg_date".

Maya Ortiz: I'll add an annotated layer in the Figma file with HubSpot field mappings and sample Zapier mapping. Will tag @Leah R. for final routing rules.

Leah R.: Confirming: Sales ops will accept 'webinar' leads with score >= 50 or tag 'benchmark' into SDR queue. Example JSON payload to demo mapping:

```
{
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "firstName": "Jane",
  "score": 75,
  "tag": "benchmark",
  "redwood_source": "web-ad-aug24",
  "webinar_reg_date": "2024-08-12T16:00:00Z"
}
```

Jonas Li: I'll include the sample screen and export-ready assets. ETA: Monday morning for final exports.

Sam Park: Thanks everyone. Once assets are uploaded I'll run a 30-min review. @Priya please brand sign-off, @LegalBot quick pass, @Leah R. confirm routing after exports.

Priya Shah: :thumbsup: Will review Mon AM.

LegalBot: :white_check_mark: Changes noted; OK to proceed. Reopen if any specific comparative claims are added.

Alex Kim: Uploaded draft exports to Figma prototype; pinged internal reviewers. :rocket:

Sam Park: Great — keeping this thread updated. Thanks all!
